_comment: Rates the agent-exporter uses to estimate per-agent cost, in USD per million tokens.
Edit this file and restart agent-exporter to re-price all history — the exporter is
stateless, so every scrape recomputes from scratch and old runs re-price too.
Each agent's tier is read from the `model:` line in its own .claude/agents/**/*.md
frontmatter, so an agent moved from opus to sonnet re-prices with no change here.
Why this is an estimate: the run log records output tokens and cached-input re-read,
but not fresh input or cache-creation tokens. Those are the small terms (across all
history: ~935M cache-read vs ~8.8M output), so the ranking is sound and the absolute
number is a floor, not a bill. Read real dollars off the Agent Performance dashboard.
Sonnet 5 carries introductory pricing of 2.00/10.00 through 2026-08-31; the standard
3.00/15.00 is used here so the series doesn't step when the promo ends.
